dedupe_keys.name: compilation of data used to implement floodplain dem algorithm in the logone floodplain

description: Shastry and Durand deposit terrain-model stages and observed flood-boundary coordinates for the Logone floodplain in Cameroon. Zenodo lists a public NetCDF DEM ensemble and a ZIP of Excel boundary tables under CC BY 4.0. The description specifies a 500 m upscaled MERIT prior DEM, fifty spatially perturbed particles, channel-smoothed and flood-boundary-smoothed ensembles, and a water-surface-constrained ensemble for a data-assimilation study. Boundary spreadsheets encode date-stamped flooded regions in WGS84 UTM Zone 33N coordinates. These inputs can benchmark floodplain-topography uncertainty or test inundation simulation sensitivity to terrain corrections. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this Logone data package. A limitation is that the page documents DEM stages, not a ready-to-run flood solver or measured water-depth time series. The provider does not quantify positional uncertainty of every boundary in the landing description. Neither NetCDF nor ZIP was downloaded, and no ensemble member was inspected or reproduced.
